decisive_items: Neck ultrasound failed to identify the thyroid gland in its normal pretracheal location
several adjacent 1 cm nodular structures enhanced similarly to thyroid tissue, and no thyroid gland was seen in the usual neck location
response.rationale: Ectopic thyroid tissue is strongly supported by absence of normal thyroid and enhancing nodules resembling thyroid at tongue base; thyroglossal duct cyst lacks these key findings.

rejected.why: No mention of absent thyroid or thyroid-like enhancement; location and calcifications are nonspecific.
